briefs.claim_en: Under the Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Yojana 2026, the government is providing free laptops to all students.
briefs.brief_en: The claim that the Indian government is providing free laptops to all students under the "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Yojana 2026" is false. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check has repeatedly debunked these claims, stating that no such scheme is being run by the central government. Multiple fact-checking organizations, including Vishvas News and DigitEye India, have also rated this claim as false, noting that such messages are often scams designed to collect personal information. While there is no central government scheme, some state governments, such as Delhi and Madhya Pradesh, offer laptop schemes or financial assistance for students.
